brand.heroDesc1: With thoughtful attention to each individual,
brand.heroDesc2: we strive for natural, balanced beauty.
brand.storyText1: At AHN’S, it is about more than change.
brand.storyText2: We consider each person’s daily life,
brand.storyPhotoAlt: Concept image of a calm space with sunlight and plants
brand.valuesIntro1: Beauty begins with the journey, not just the outcome.
brand.valuesIntro2: We keep people at the center of every decision.
brand.v1Copy: We listen carefully and explore what truly matters together.
brand.v2Copy: We consider individual features and overall harmony for a natural look.
brand.v3Copy: We aim to offer attentive care from consultation through recovery.
brand.spaceAlt: Warm sunlight in a tranquil space
brand.spaceDesc1: From welcoming spaces to conversations that matter,

philosophy.heroDesc: Beauty is not a single standard. It is harmony discovered in each individual face and story.
philosophy.belief1Body: We start by listening to your concerns and expectations. Care begins with the person, not a procedure.
philosophy.belief2Body: Rather than offering the same answer to everyone, we discuss options in light of individual needs and overall balance.
philosophy.belief3Body: We aim to help you understand possible methods, limitations and precautions before deciding.

doctors.heroDesc: Introducing our medical team is about more than credentials. It is about our approach to care and conversation.

doctors.card2Desc: Only verified specialties and descriptions are published.
doctors.card3Desc: Verified qualifications and academic activities will be listed.

facilities.heroDesc: Some spaces speak before words. Discover the calm light, textures and thoughtful flow we value.
facilities.conceptNotice: * Images are design concepts and should be replaced with actual clinic photos.
facilities.bodyDesc: A welcoming space is part of thoughtful care. We hope a calm atmosphere makes your time before and after consultations more comfortable.
facilities.bottomTitle: We look forward to welcoming you.

safety.heroDesc: Good care is more than visible outcomes. We value clear explanations, thoughtful decisions and communication throughout care.
safety.step1Text: We begin by discussing your current condition, goals, medical history and concerns.
safety.step2Text: We explain possible approaches, limitations and precautions to support informed decisions.
safety.step3Text: Discuss options with medical professionals based on individual circumstances and findings.
safety.step4Text: Review recovery progress and precautions, and discuss any remaining questions.
safety.note1Desc: Before treatment, we value reviewing relevant information, foreseeable limitations and general precautions.
safety.note2Desc: We encourage questions and thoughtful decisions after understanding the options.
safety.note3Desc: For specific care procedures and their availability, consult the medical team and verified clinic information.
safety.bottomTitle: Take your time to make an informed choice.
